column1: # A typed line's name and Menge (job 61): app/lib/list/entry.dart parseEntry and the server's
# public.parse_item read every row the same (tested by app/test/list/entry_test.dart and the db
# gate's supabase/functions/_shared/add_paths_integration_test.ts). A bare number at the end is
# the Menge only when it is 1 to 20, does not follow a size or unit word, and the rest is a word
# the dictionary knows or the household bought before (history). The server's name here is its
# name and Eigenschaften joined ("Windeln" + "Größe 4"). Tab-separated; an empty cell is none.
# Said is different (job 89): the voice splitter (supabase/functions/voice/parse.ts, parse_en.ts;
# Siri, Alexa, in-app dictation) reads any count said after the item as the Menge, as a word or
# digits. A row with mode `typed` is only typed, one with `spoken` only said; no mode is both.
# lang is the splitter a said row goes through: de (none) or en.
